name: singlet_communication_ligand_activity_inference
title: Ligand activity inference for a receiver response
description: Ranks candidate sender ligands by how well their prior ligand-to-target potential explains a receiver population's response genes, and returns ligand-to-target links. Requires a precomputed receiver DE table and expressed-gene background; the prior is built if absent. Use the default nichenet_aupr method; ulm and mlm are model-based comparators. Do not use on cell-level expression alone, because the score needs an aggregated DE table.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

receiver.description: Receiver cell-type label whose DE table defines the response gene set.

method.description: nichenet_aupr is the published default; ulm and mlm are linear-model comparators.

de.description: Thresholds that select response genes from the receiver DE table.

logfc_threshold.description: Minimum absolute log fold change for a response gene.

pvalue_threshold.description: P-value threshold for a response gene.

use_adjusted_pvalue.description: Apply the p-value threshold to adjusted p-values.

top_n_targets.description: Number of top response genes kept for ligand-target links.

prior.description: Prior construction options; used only when the prior is built here.

ltf_cutoff.description: Quantile below which ligand-to-node PageRank scores are set to zero.

damping_factor.description: Probability that the random walker continues; restart probability is one minus this.

secondary_targets.description: Include second-order targets in the ligand-target matrix.

bootstrap.description: Random gene-set null used for nichenet_aupr p-values.

n_iter.description: Number of random gene sets of equal size drawn from receiver expressed genes.

metric.description: Ligand activity metric compared against the null.

candidates.description: Candidate ligand set and the number of ligands reported.

senders.description: Sender cell-type labels whose expressed ligands are candidates; if omitted, all ligands in the prior are candidates.

top_n_ligands.description: Number of top-ranked ligands reported with their target links.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for the bootstrap null gene sets.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/ligand_activities/<receiver>. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, receiver, n_candidate_ligands, n_response_genes, n_background_genes, top_ligands (ligand, aupr_corrected, p_value_bootstrap), warnings.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
